components.css: .ds-ledger { background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink); border:1px solid #dfe5e9; border-radius:10px; overflow:hidden; } .ds-ledger table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; text-align:right; font:11px "Manrope Variable",sans-serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-ledger thead { background:#f9fafb; color:#69737d; } .ds-ledger thead th { font-size:9px; font-weight:500; padding:11px 12px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); } .ds-ledger th:first-child { text-align:left; padding-left:23px; } .ds-ledger tbody tr { border-bottom:1px solid #edf0f2; } .ds-ledger tbody tr:hover { background:#fbfcfc; } .ds-ledger tbody th { padding:17px 12px 17px 22px; font-weight:500; } .ds-ledger td { padding:20px 12px; color:#48515e; } .ds-company { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:5px; text-align:left; border:0; background:none; padding:0; color:var(--ink); font:11px "Manrope Variable",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-company strong { font-weight:650; letter-spacing:.1px; } .ds-company>span,.ds-date { display:block; font-size:9px; color:#69737d; } .ds-date { margin-top:5px; line-height:1.4; } .ds-company:hover strong { color:var(--accent); } .ds-company:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-ledger .ds-value { font-weight:600; color:#303944; } .ds-ledger .ds-ledger-gain { color:var(--positive); } @media(max-width:720px) { .ds-ledger { border-radius:8px; } .ds-ledger thead th { padding:10px 8px; font-size:8px; } .ds-ledger th:first-child { padding-left:14px; } .ds-ledger tbody th { padding:15px 8px 15px 14px; } .ds-ledger td { padding:17px 8px; font-size:10px; } .ds-company { font-size:10px; } .ds-company>span,.ds-date { font-size:8px; } }

narrative.overview:
Equities follows the user-pinned Tax UI reference: an open financial summary above a compact white ledger. Pale cool paper, ink text, forest actions, fine dividers, and small stroke icons support close inspection of holdings.

The interface is restrained and information-dense. Manrope provides both headings and compact labels; aligned tabular numerals give money and quantities a consistent rhythm. Company initials are text badges, not invented logos. This record describes the implemented interface in src/styles.css, src/App.tsx, and src/components/PortfolioPanels.tsx; the reviewed desktop and mobile captures agree with that source.
keyCharacteristics: Open totals and a bordered ledger.
Forest actions with restrained green/red financial states.
Compact labels, tabular figures, and dated prices.
Flat resting surfaces; overlays carry the shadows.
dos: Do use the existing forest action color and Manrope family.
Do align financial columns with tabular numerals and keep signs, percentages, and labels alongside color.
Do retain visible price dates, unpriced states, and the labeled example banner.
Do preserve keyboard focus outlines and the reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep wide directory content inside its scrolling container on narrow screens.
donts: Don't turn the current open summary into a stack of nested cards.
Don't replace the text company badges with invented company logos.
Don't present an individual-stock price history as a portfolio performance chart.
Don't remove the example label or imply the illustrative holdings are the visitor's saved holdings.
